overall_goal: Add butter, onions, and seasoning to the pan and cook until soft

goals.description: Cut and melt butter in the pan
goals.rationale: The person retrieves butter, cuts a slab, adds it to the frying pan, and swirls the pan to melt and spread the butter.

goals.description: Add onions and seasoning to the pan
goals.rationale: The person pours the chopped onions and the remaining stroganoff seasoning into the frying pan.

goals.description: Stir the mixture and adjust the heat to cook
goals.rationale: The person repeatedly stirs the onions and seasoning in the pan, adjusting the hob heat to cook them evenly.
